title: Curology Prescription Failure Rate
dataSources: Curology prescriptions (`curology:prescription`), skin diaries (`skin:diary`), dermatology appointments (`derm:appointment`), and UV exposure logs (`uv:exposure`).
app: Curology prescription shipments, daily skin diary entries, dermatology appointment exports, and UV exposure tracker logs ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=curology:prescription
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(rx_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by formula_name
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often Curology prescription records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each formula.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize rx_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per formula.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It maps which parts of your Curology prescription data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
